text:
Mia (PM): Quick sync — post-launch candidate priorities. We have 3 P1 bugs from last night, + a handful of customer enhancement asks. Need to decide what goes into the next patch vs next minor release.
Alex (Eng): show me the P1 list?
Mia (PM): 
- BUG-401: streaming timeout on >8k tokens (high impact for enterprise customers)
- BUG-412: rare KV cache leak on multi-tenant paths
- BUG-418: embeddings indexing mismatch for short texts
- ENH-77: paginator UX for long conversation history (customer ask)
- ENH-84: admin-facing cost/latency per-route breakdown (enterprise ask)
Sam (SRE): Streaming timeout is causing backpressure spikes, seen in eu-west3 cluster. We hit the circuit-breaker 2x.
Julie (Support): BUG-401 is driving 3 open tickets from one big customer; they're asking for ETA.
Dennis (Data): BUG-418 affects ~4% of embedding requests for queries < 12 chars — measurable but narrow.
Alex (Eng): My take: BUG-401 and BUG-412 are safety/regression territory — patch window. BUG-418 could be tagged for rollout fix next minor unless we see customer escalations.
Mia (PM): Proposal: freeze candidate patch to only fixes with either clear customer impact (tickets) or reliability risk. So 401 + 412 go patch; 418 and enhancements go to minor.
Julie (Support): +1 for quick patch on 401, customers are already onboarding.
Sam (SRE): Need to validate patch doesn't change batching semantics — schedule a canary in prod for 30m. Canary owner: @Alex.
Alex (Eng): I'll own the canary. Plan: branch -> small canary -> monitor 30m -> promote. Deployment command we'll use: `opsbot deploy canary streaming-fix --region eu-west3`
opsbot: Canary deployment created: streaming-fix-canary-1778887770. Monitoring hooks: latency, error-rate, circuit-breaker-trips.
Mia (PM): For scope and acceptance criteria:
- BUG-401: end-to-end streaming errors reduced to <0.1% in canary window and no circuit-breaker triggers for 30m.
- BUG-412: no KV leak across 1M requests in staging load test.
- BUG-418: regression test added to embedding suite; gate for next minor.
Dennis (Data): I'll add metrics dashboards and a short eval set for 418 so we can track post-rollout regressions.
Alex (Eng): Timeline: patch cut today EOD, canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC, full rollout if green by 15:00 UTC.
Mia (PM): Owners: Alex (canary + rollout), Sam (slo and rollback runbook), Dennis (metrics), Julie (customer comms).
Julie (Support): I'll draft an interim note to affected customers: ETA and mitigation steps.
Mia (PM): Enhancements (ENH-77, ENH-84) — schedule planning: put on next minor board, rough T-shirt sizing today, prioritize by customer ARR + implementation effort.
Alex (Eng): Quick notes: ENH-84 touches billing pipeline — needs cross-team sync with finance. Might be medium effort.
Mia (PM): Decision summary: patch = BUG-401, BUG-412. Next minor = BUG-418 + ENH-77 + ENH-84. Canary owner: Alex. SLO guard: Sam. Customer comms: Julie. Dennis to add dashboards.
Sam (SRE): I'll prep rollback steps and a throttling flag we can flip if we see spikes.
Alex (Eng): Will open PRs today with clear changelogs.
Julie (Support): Sending customer note after Alex confirms canary schedule.
Mia (PM): Thanks — we'll reconvene after canary results. If anything changes ping here and @channel for urgent updates :bell:
